comment: Bambu Lab model codes, as the printers announce them in SSDP DevModel and report as project_name, and as the model_id of each machine in OrcaSlicer's BBL profiles. Bambu Studio also names the H2C O1C, and reads the 3DPrinter-X1 and 3DPrinter-X1-Carbon of old X1 firmware as BL-P002 and BL-P001 (_parse_printer_type). Values are the printer catalog's model names. sx-connect and the catalog tests read this file.
